Jangan abaikan bercak putih di lidah ya bund 😊

Lidah bayi yang putih bisa disebabkan oleh sisa susu yang normal, TAPI bisa juga menjadi salah satu tanda “oral thrush” atau infeksi jamur.

Perhatikan perbedaannya ya~ namun perlu diingat bahwa hal diatas adalah “ciri-ciri” bukan diagnosis. Jika bercak susu sulit dibersihkan dan si kecil tidak nyaman saat menyusu, bisa langsung dikonsultasikan ke dokter anak ya 🥰 

Nah, tips untuk mencegah sisa susu agar tidak menjadi infeksi jamur dengan cara :
✅ Bersihkan mulut bayi 1-2 kali sehari dengan kassa basah (dicelup air hangat), secara perlahan di bagian lidah, gusi, maupun dalam pipi
✅ Jika menyusu dengan botol, Sterilkan botol, dot dengan baik 
✅ Jangan biarkan sisa susu menempel lama di lidah bayi

Dengan perawatan bayi baru lahir (newborncare treatment) dan paket selapan di naluriibu.id, bubid bakal ajarin gimana cara membersihkan lidah bayi agar mencegah oral thrush 🤗

Bayi nangis setiap ditinggal sebentar, bahkan sama ayahnya sendiri? Jangan buru-buru dibilang manja, ya, Mom!

Bisa jadi, si kecil sedang mengalami Separation Anxiety alias kecemasan saat berpisah dari orang terdekatnya.

Fase ini umumnya mulai terlihat di usia 6–9 bulan. Bayi mulai menyadari saat Mommy tidak ada di dekatnya, tetapi belum sepenuhnya memahami bahwa Mommy akan kembali.

Makanya, si kecil bisa menangis, rewel, ingin digendong terus, atau menolak saat digendong orang lain.

Gimana cara membantu si kecil melewati fase ini?
• Biasakan berpamitan sebelum pergi.
• Latih berpisah secara bertahap.
• Ciptakan rutinitas yang konsisten.
• Berikan ketenangan saat si kecil menangis.
• Manfaatkan momen menggendong untuk membantu si kecil merasa aman.

Ingat, Mom, bayi bukan sedang memanipulasi atau sengaja merepotkanmu. Dia sedang belajar memahami dunia yang lebih luas, sambil mencari rasa aman dari orang yang paling dia percaya.

Jika kecemasannya sangat berat, berlangsung terus-menerus, atau mengganggu aktivitas sehari-hari, konsultasikan dengan dokter anak.

Sering refleks bilang “Anak Hebat!” atau “Good Job!” setiap kali si kecil berhasil melakukan sesuatu? 

Ternyata, ada cara yang lebih baik lho, Moms! 🥺💔

Pujian yang terlalu umum seperti itu memang niatnya baik, tapi tanpa sadar bisa membuat anak jadi “haus pujian”. 

Mereka jadi lebih fokus pada hasil akhir (“Aku hebat!”) daripada menghargai proses dan usaha yang sudah mereka lakukan. 

Akibatnya? Anak bisa jadi takut mencoba hal baru karena cemas tidak akan dapat pujian lagi.

Jadi, apa yang sebaiknya kita katakan untuk memuji usaha mereka? 🤔👇

💬 “Wah, Mamy lihat kamu kerja keras banget menyusun balok itu sampai tinggi!”
🎯 Ini memvalidasi USAHA-nya, bukan hanya hasilnya. Anak merasa prosesnya dihargai.

💬 “Ceritain dong, bagian mana yang paling kamu suka dari gambarmu ini?”
🎯 Ini mendorong anak untuk menilai karyanya sendiri dan bangga dari dalam, bukan dari luar.

💬 “Ide kamu bagus banget pakai selimut buat jadi benteng!”
🎯 Puji STRATEGI atau ide spesifik yang mereka gunakan. Ini membuat mereka merasa cerdas dan kreatif.

Dengan memuji prosesnya, kita bantu anak membangun mental yang kuat, tidak mudah menyerah, dan percaya pada kemampuannya sendiri. 🌱💖

Kalau Moms, biasanya paling sering ngomong apa untuk memuji si kecil? Yuk, sharing di bawah! 👇✨

"Kenapa anakku jadi pemalu ya, gampang takut, atau suka melawan?"

Bisa jadi… tanpa sadar, kitalah yang membentuk karakter itu lewat pola asuh sehari-hari.

Yuk, kita pahami satu per satu:

👧 Anak jadi pembangkang?
Bisa karena sering dibentak atau dimarahi tanpa penjelasan yang jelas. Anak bingung harus bagaimana, akhirnya melawan.

😨 Anak penakut?
Kalimat seperti “AWAS YA!” bisa membuat anak hidup dalam ketakutan, bukan kesadaran.

🤐 Anak introvert dan minder?
Jika anak tak diberi ruang untuk bicara, ia akan memilih diam karena merasa suaranya tak penting.

😥 Anak manja dan mudah rapuh?
Kebiasaan memenuhi semua keinginannya membuat anak sulit menghadapi ‘tidak’ dan tantangan.

⚠️ Anak suka membangkang lagi?
Mungkin karena ia sering dibandingkan, dimarahi saat gagal, tanpa dihargai usahanya.

🎯 Ingat: anak belajar dari cara kita menyikapi mereka. Ucapan dan perlakuan kecil bisa membentuk kepribadian besar di masa depan.

Mari refleksi dan perbaiki.

Tips berhasil toilet training versi aku:

1. Siapin mental ibunya ✨
Kalau aku dibuat slowww aja, gak maksa / target cepet2 lulus, jd bs lebih enjoy & less stress

2. Hari pertama, pasang alarm tiap 30 menit.
Ajak ke toilet untuk pipis. Kadang keluar, kadang enggak, kadang keburu ngompol di celana. Wajaaaar. Tapi dari tiap 30 menit itu anak mulai ‘meraba’ rasa ingin pipis. Kalau poop, tiap mulai keliatan ngeden LANGSUNG gendong ngibrit ke WC! Meskipun kadang cuma prank krn udah sampe WC gak keluar -_- tapi disitu dia mulai meraba rasa mules haha

3. Meskipun kita lg capek, jgn sekali-kali marahin anaknya kl lg ngompol / poop sembarangan. Kasih pengertian terus, sounding terus…

4. Appreciate tiap anak berhasil pee / poop di toilet. 
Bisa dgn tepuk tangan sambil heboh “yeay anak hebattt!” etc krn anak kecil tuh pinter, ketika dia lihat kita proud / happy gitu pasti pgn dia ulangin lagi. Akhirnya semangat lagi mau pee / poop di toilet 😃

5. Beliin CD gambar2 lucu favoritnya, suruh dia pilih biar makin semangat

6. Udah segitu aja, sisanya biar waktu yg menjawab. 
Soon or later akan berhasil kok, mulai aja dulu :)

Capeknya kita akan bener-bener terbayar pas anaknya udah berhasil lepas diapers. Selamat mencoba ✨ & semangat! ❤️

Anak bilang bosan, langsung dikasih HP biar anteng?

Peneliti University of Michigan mengikuti 422 anak usia 3-5 tahun selama beberapa bulan. Hasilnya, makin sering orang tua memakai HP untuk menenangkan anak, emosi anak makin mudah meledak dan moodnya makin naik turun, terutama pada anak laki-laki.

HP memang bikin diam, tapi anak kehilangan kesempatan belajar menenangkan diri sendiri.

Padahal bosan ada manfaatnya. Dalam penelitian di Inggris, peserta yang disuruh menyalin nomor telepon selama 15 menit, lalu diminta mencari kegunaan gelas plastik, menghasilkan ide lebih banyak dibanding yang tidak dibuat bosan.

📌 Bosan bukan masalah yang harus langsung diberesin
📌 Kasih waktu anak cari mainan dan ide sendiri

Sumber: Radesky JS, dkk. JAMA Pediatrics 2022; Mann S & Cadman R. Creativity Research Journal 2014

🦷 Kapan sih gigi susu anak mulai copot?

Ternyata, pergantian gigi susu anak punya tahapan usianya, lho! 

Yuk, kenali beberapa tahapannya:

🌱 Usia 6–7 tahun
Biasanya dua gigi seri tengah bagian atas mulai tanggal.

🌱 Usia 7–8 tahun
Pergantian berlanjut pada gigi seri di sebelahnya.

🌱 Usia 9–12 tahun
Gigi lainnya mulai mengalami pergantian secara bertahap.

Perlu diingat, ini merupakan perkiraan usia. Setiap anak bisa memiliki waktu pertumbuhan dan pergantian gigi yang berbeda-beda.

Yuk, Bunda mulai kenali tahapan pergantian gigi anak agar kita tidak bingung saat si kecil mulai ompong. 😍

4. Lambat bicara dibanding teman seusianya

Sama seperti otot tubuh yang perlu "olahraga", otot mulut juga perlu stimulasi rutin biar makin kuat dan lentur. Semakin sering dilatih sejak dini, semakin siap anak untuk mengucapkan kata-kata dengan jelas dan percaya diri.

Feeding to sleep is one of the most common things families are told to stop doing. And it’s one of the most effective, biologically appropriate sleep supports that exists.
 
Here’s what’s actually happening when you feed your baby to sleep: warm milk triggers the release of cholecystokinin, a hormone that induces drowsiness. The physical closeness regulates your baby’s heart rate, temperature and breathing. The act of suckling activates the parasympathetic nervous system - the rest and digest state - which is precisely the state a baby needs to be in to move into sleep.
 
In other words, your body created the perfect sleep environment. The advice to stop using it wasn’t built on developmental biology. It was built on the cultural expectation that babies should fall asleep independently, which is a social preference, not a biological one.

How to Sleep Train Your Baby
Month-by-Month Breakdown

Sleep training is one of the most searched parenting topics, but most parents are never told that healthy sleep starts long before a baby sleeps through the night.

The goal is not perfection. The goal is helping babies build healthy sleep habits step by step.

0–1 month
Newborns are not ready for schedules. Focus on feeding, bonding, and safe sleep.

1–2 months
Babies begin separating day from night. Natural light during the day and dark quiet nights help regulate sleep.

2–3 months
Simple bedtime routines begin to matter. Repeating the same calming cues helps signal sleep.

3–4 months
Sleep cycles mature during the four month regression. Consistency becomes more important than ever.

4–6 months
Wake windows matter. Overtired babies struggle the most with falling and staying asleep.

6–9 months

Most parents stress about this at bedtime and honestly, that makes sense (it was me too!) 
Figuring out how warm (or cool) your baby should be can feel surprisingly confusing.

One thing I teach every family I work with is this:
checking hands and feet won’t actually tell you much about your baby’s temperature.

Babies regulate heat differently than adults, so their extremities are often cooler, even when their core is totally comfortable.

So here’s the temperature check that actually matters 👇🏻

HOW to do a temperature check-in:
• Gently place your fingers on your baby’s chest or upper back/back of neck
• You’re looking for warm + dry
• Not hot, sweaty, or clammy

If their chest feels too warm or damp, that’s your cue to remove a layer or adjust the room and reassess.

A few guidelines to support that check:
• Most comfortable sleep spaces fall in the 68–72°F range
• Airflow matters: AC, fans, vents, or no AC at all can change how layers feel
• Ask yourself: am I comfortable in this room right now?
• Choose breathable fabrics and adjust layers with the season
• When in doubt, it’s generally safer for babies to be slightly cooler than too warm

This isn’t about creating worry, it’s about giving you a simple tool so bedtime feels calmer and more confident! 🤍

Every 1–2 hours, the brain naturally moves through a full sleep cycle and briefly wakes to “check in.”

If everything feels the same - same room, same position, same environment - you (or your baby) drift right back to sleep and never even remember it.

But if something’s different: the pacifier’s missing, the rocking stopped, mom isn’t there, the boob is gone. That tiny wakeup turns into a full wakeup with crying.

Does your baby wake as soon as you try to put them down? 😩

Your sweet little newborn loves to sleep on you, and while it is ✨magical✨ it can also be overwhelming and it’s ok to want/need a break and to be able to put them down every now and then.

If you’re finding it difficult to transition your little one from your arms to their bassinet/cot/crib, try these tips 👇🏼

🧡 Swaddle and make sure they’re dressed appropriately for the room temp so they stay nice and warm without your body heat.

🧡 Settle your baby to sleep in your arms and wait about 10-15 minutes until they’re in a deep sleep before transferring.

OR

You can also settle your little one until drowsy, or awake but calm, and follow these tips to settle hands on.

🧡 Slowly lower them, placing their feet down first, then body, then head. If space allows, you can also keep your body close to theirs as you lower them.

🧡 If they stir, or if you’ve placed them down drowsy or awake, roll them onto their side and gently pat their back while supporting them with your other hand. You can also make a rhythmic shushing noise to help soothe.

🧡 Continue patting and shushing until they are asleep.

🧡 Gently roll them to their back. Keep one hand with slight pressure on their chest while slowly stopping the patting.

🧡 Once you’re sure they’re asleep, remove your hands and voila 🪄

⚠️ Diaclaimer: this might not work the first (or second or third) time you try, but practicing regularly (even just once a day, a few days a week) will help your baby become familiar with settling/sleeping in their bassinet/cot/crib.

Bassinet naps also may not be as long as contact naps to start with, but having 30 minutes here and there with bub asleep and your arms free can make big difference to your day.

You can also use the same tips to attempt to resettle and extend naps in the bassinet, or just finish short naps off in your arms 🤗

😴 Babies are little creatures of habit. They crave rhythms and routines. They’re also tired and WANT to sleep. They just don’t know how. So here’s what NOT to do…and what you can do to help elongate these naps.

1. Do NOT race in the room! Stirring between sleep cycles is normal…and we want to give our babies a change to settle themselves.
2. Do NOT get up and immediately feed! This is hard but I promise it will help. If you choose to end the nap and feed…that’s fine! But try and wait 10 minutes. Feeding isn’t wrong at all but babies can begin to associate waking early into a nap and getting fed immediately. Feeding in another location can help too! 
3. Do NOT choose a rescue nap that is their biggest sleep association! If they only want to sleep if they’re being rocked..the rescue nap in a carrier or on a drive. If they only want to feed, try rocking without feeding.

But what can you do to help?! 

1. Begin waking at the same time each morning. This will set the stage for naps and help your baby’s circadian rhythm. 
2. Practice crib hour…you can interval check or soothe but practice working towards time in crib even if it’s not successful day one. 
3. Try wake to sleep…gently go into their room a bit before they wake and turn up the sound machine or lightly touch their back. This can help them cross over to the next sleep cycle!
